text:
maya: FYI conversion job for model 'llama-mini-2026' failing during post-convert checks. saw missing tokens in chat template eval.

maya: log extract:
```
ERROR: shard index mismatch: expected 00001.safetensors, got 0001.safetensors
HTTP 401 when fetching https://cdn.hf-example/models/llama-mini/00001.safetensors
KeyError: 'weight_key.prefix_embeddings'
```
cheng: hm looks like weight key rename and index mismatch combined. hub index points at old shard names (zero padded) but the upstream revision was republished with keys renamed.
eli: also observed token ids shifting after quant + tokenizer rewrite. special tokens disappeared from `config.json` -> chat template no longer maps `<|assistant|>`
maya: reproducible locally with `convert-to-redwood --rev pin=refs/changes/3` — the tool accepts the rev string but the hub client falls back to latest and we get auth errors when CDN keys rotate.
cheng: probable cause: revision pin not propagated to CDN fetcher; converter writes index with new weight key names but leaves original shard filenames in index. will open quick patch to normalize weight names and reserialize index.
cheng: diff:
```
- 'embed.weight' -> 'model.embed.weight'
+ 'embed.weight' -> 'model.embed.weight'
```
eli: can we also add a check that `config.json['special_tokens_map']` exists post-convert? that would catch chat template breakage earlier.
devon: assign to cheng, run evals: `make -C evals run MODEL=llama-mini-2026` and add a non-regression for special tokens. keep me posted.
ci-bot: build 4482 failed on integration tests: converter-integration -> test-tokenizer-regression
maya: created branch `fix/weight-index-normalize` and pushed PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/234
maya: added fallback to retry CDN fetch with anonymous creds if 401 on pinned revision.
eli: note: quant experiments show 0.8% ROUGE drop if we remap tokenizer thresholds wrong — need compare before/after in the PR
devon: quick smoke: deploy pipeline with branch to staging dedicated and run `evals/bench/throughput.sh` after CI green.
maya: thanks everyone. will follow up when PR merges. :thumbsup:
